description_for_human: Search Eon backups and restore Microsoft 365 and cloud data.
description_for_model: Eon backup and recovery. These tools find Microsoft 365 users, SharePoint sites and teams protected by Eon, search their snapshots for emails and files, restore them, report on backup and restore jobs, list ransomware and malware findings in backups, and take on-demand snapshots of cloud resources.

functions.name: list_projects
functions.description: Lists the Eon projects the signed-in user can access. Every other tool needs a project ID.

functions.name: list_resources
functions.description: Lists the resources Eon protects in a project, including the Microsoft 365 tenant when includeSaas is true.

functions.name: get_resource
functions.description: Gets one protected resource's details, including its backup status.

functions.name: list_resource_snapshots
functions.description: Lists the snapshots of a protected resource.

functions.name: list_saas_entities
functions.description: Lists the users, SharePoint sites and teams of a Microsoft 365 tenant resource.

functions.name: list_saas_entity_snapshots
functions.description: Lists the snapshots that captured one Microsoft 365 user, site or team.

functions.name: search_saas_user_mail
functions.description: Searches a user's mailbox in one snapshot and returns the matching messages.

functions.name: search_saas_user_drive
functions.description: Searches a user's OneDrive in one snapshot and returns the matching files and folders.

functions.name: search_saas_shared_drive
functions.description: Searches a SharePoint site's libraries in one snapshot and returns the matching files and folders.

functions.name: search_saas_team
functions.description: Searches a Microsoft Teams team in one snapshot and returns the matching channels and conversations.

functions.name: list_restore_accounts
functions.description: Lists the restore accounts that can run a restore, including the Microsoft 365 restore account.

functions.name: list_backup_jobs
functions.description: Lists backup jobs with their status, to find failed or partial backups.

functions.name: list_restore_jobs
functions.description: Lists restore jobs with their status.

functions.name: get_restore_job
functions.description: Gets one restore job's status and details.

functions.name: list_infected_snapshots
functions.description: Lists a resource's snapshots with ransomware or malware findings, to find the last clean recovery point.

functions.name: list_security_findings
functions.description: Lists ransomware, malware and data anomaly findings across protected resources.

functions.name: get_my_action_approval_request
functions.description: Gets the status of an approval request the signed-in user created.

functions.name: restore_microsoft365_user_mail_by_entity
functions.description: Restores selected messages from a snapshot into a new folder in the user's mailbox.

confirmation.title: Restore mail
confirmation.body: Do you want to restore the selected mail from this Eon snapshot into a new folder in the mailbox?

functions.name: restore_microsoft365_user_drive_by_entity
functions.description: Restores selected OneDrive items from a snapshot, overwriting items with the same path.

confirmation.title: Restore OneDrive items
confirmation.body: Do you want to restore the selected OneDrive items from this Eon snapshot? Items with the same path are overwritten.

functions.name: restore_microsoft365_share_point_site_by_entity
functions.description: Restores selected SharePoint items from a snapshot, overwriting items with the same path.

confirmation.title: Restore SharePoint items
confirmation.body: Do you want to restore the selected SharePoint items from this Eon snapshot? Items with the same path are overwritten.

functions.name: restore_microsoft365_team_by_entity
functions.description: Restores selected Microsoft Teams data from a snapshot.

confirmation.title: Restore Teams data
confirmation.body: Do you want to restore the selected Teams data from this Eon snapshot?

functions.name: restore_microsoft365_user_by_entity
functions.description: Restores a user's mailbox and OneDrive from a snapshot in one job.

confirmation.title: Restore user data
confirmation.body: Do you want to restore this user's Microsoft 365 data from this Eon snapshot?

functions.name: take_snapshot
functions.description: Starts an on-demand snapshot of a protected resource.

confirmation.title: Take a snapshot
confirmation.body: Do you want Eon to take an on-demand snapshot of this resource now?

functions.name: create_action_approval_request
functions.description: Submits or discards an action approval request so administrators can review a restore.

confirmation.title: Send for approval
confirmation.body: Do you want to send this Eon action request to the approvers?
